thread:
maria_support: FYI customer (acme_platform) reporting truncated SSE output when their auth proxy rotates tokens mid-stream. They consistently get a JSON parse error because the final choice/finish object never arrives.

acme_platform: repro notes — long generation, during token refresh our proxy aborts the upstream request and immediately opens a new one. It only happens ~15-25% of long streams. Attached sample payload (we receive):
```
event: message
data: {"id":"r-abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Part 1\n"},"index":0}]}

event: message
data: {"id":"r-abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Part 2"},"index":0}]}

event: message
data: {"id":"r-abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"End..."},"index":0}]}
```
acme_platform: then socket EOF, client parser errors: 'Unexpected end of JSON input' because no final finish chunk `{"finish_reason":"stop"}` or closing array/object.

maria_support: can you share the request/response headers and any edge logs? Also which client?

acme_platform: headers: `HTTP/2 200`, `content-type: text/event-stream`, `transfer-encoding: chunked`, `connection: keep-alive`. Right before EOF we see `: ping

` then RST; client is node 18, internal fetch wrapper that calls `req.abort()` when token refresh needed and immediately re-requests.

kevin_frontend: note: aborting underlying socket mid-stream can drop buffered writes in proxies. Need to check if runtime emitted the finalizer or if it was lost in flight. Do you have our runtime trace id?

acme_platform: provided three ids: rwd-req-9a3b, rwd-req-9c7d, rwd-req-a1f0. Edge logs show `edge_close: RST_STREAM CANCEL`, backend returned 200, bytes_sent ~4KB. No final finish event found in server logs for those ids.

ops-bot: fastly excerpt for rwd-req-9a3b: `edge_action: client_reset(RST_STREAM 0x8 CANCEL)`, `backend_status: 200`, `client_bytes: 4120`, `backend_bytes: 4132`.

sunita_eng: runtime log snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] rwd-req-9a3b chunk seq=1 len=128
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] rwd-req-9a3b chunk seq=2 len=1024
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] rwd-req-9a3b chunk seq=3 len=512
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] rwd-req-9a3b finalizer emitted_finish=false close_reason=client_disconnect
```

sunita_eng: that `emitted_finish=false` indicates the finalizer didn't write the finish JSON. Hypothesis: on client abort the runtime cancels background finalizer tasks under backpressure. We'll instrument to ensure a best-effort synchronous finalizer runs before closing the backend stream.

kevin_frontend: capture to add: a unit/integration test that simulates client abort (HTTP/2 RST_STREAM/CANCEL) then asserts server emits a terminal sentinel (either finish chunk or a `event: done` with `partial=true`).

maria_support: customer workaround suggestions while we fix: 1) avoid aborting upstream during token refresh (try background refresh or refresh without breaking socket), 2) use short-lived segments (truncate responses), or 3) parse defensively and treat EOF as partial with retry logic.

acme_platform: their proxy cannot easily hold sockets during refresh. Any ETA? Parser errors are causing our product team to flag this as blocking for some integrations.

sunita_eng: triage and plan: (a) hotfix to run a best-effort synchronous finalizer on client disconnect — target: 7 days (hotfix branch), (b) emit explicit sentinel `event: done` with `partial: true` when finish content can't be assembled — target: follow-up minor release in ~2 weeks, (c) docs/SDK guidance about `Prefer: wait=finish` header and recommended reconnect/resume patterns — immediate.

kevin_frontend: raising severity to P2 due to customer-facing parse failures. I'll own test and QA.

maria_support: I'll communicate the hotfix ETA to the customer and collect additional request ids after deploy for verification. We'll monitor for 48h post-deploy. If still reproduces, we'll ask for full pcap and edge logs.

acme_platform: thanks — we'll validate against our integration once hotfix lands and share results.

sunita_eng: assigning follow-ups: eng-runtime to implement sync finalizer + telemetry, eng-platform to add sentinel emission and resume header support, docs to publish client guidance. I'll post PR link in this thread when ready.

kevin_frontend: quick note — for node clients, recommend avoiding `req.abort()` and instead signal the server via a small control frame or use short auth TTLs to reduce the probability of mid-stream refresh.

maria_support: closing loop for now. Support will update customer and keep watch. Will reopen thread if we see retries still fail post-hotfix. :thumbsup:
